settings.heading: Four masks, four reasons
settings.intro: We started with one mask, the silk one that goes in the box. People kept asking for it on its own, then asked for a heavier one, then for something that would survive a flight. So there are four. They are all cut in the same studio and they all use the same covered strap, because that is the part everyone gets wrong.
settings.note: Not sure which one? The silk is the safe answer and the one most people come back for. If you want it as a present, the Signature Sleep Box has the silk mask in it along with seven other pieces.
settings.empty_text: The masks are being photographed. They will be here shortly.
